retained_output.inference: All board capacitors share one 8.5V node: C84 twice nominal, others +20% tolerance and +15% temperature. No operating-load or divider-discharge credit; no U11 reverse-blocking credit. Capacitor sharing and the doubled C84 envelope are inference, requiring bench verification.

local_path_sensitivity.note: First 0.5us only: assumed U9 input capacitance 0..10nF and contact edges 0.1/1/10ns. No manufacturer capacitance/edge bounds or package ESL/ESR guarantee. All local copper remains in the model; C88 must separate U9 from the incoming feed.

lower_resistance_sensitivity.note: Outside F9 required >=0.03 ohm envelope; no battery-lead fuse assumed. Measure pack+harness resistance.
